## Question
Are there any restrictions of what can constitute the syntax of neural architectures? What about $\mathbf{Set}$ vs. hypergraph categories? Does it matter or is one preferable? Perhaps architectures can be classified based on string-diagrammatic axioms? How does this compare to descriptions of syntax in $\mathbf{Alg}(F)$, where $F:\mathbf{Para}(\mathbf{Set})\to{}\mathbf{Para}(\mathbf{Set})$, as in [gavranovic-2024-position-categorical](../../../literature/gavranovic-2024-position-categorical.md)?
